g.text: - ProductId is a unique identifier for a product.
- Must be a string representing the product ID.
- Sellable and Pizza Component are Product types.
- A Product MUST have at least one type:
• No type (neither Sellable nor Pizza Component)
- Any Product (regardless of type) may or may not
- A Pizza Component must be associated with
- For pizzas, the selling price is determined
- CategoryId is a unique identifier for a product category.
- Must be a string representing the category ID.
- AllergenId is a unique identifier for an allergen.
- Must be an integer between 1 and 14 (inclusive),
corresponding to the official EU Regulation No. 1169/2011.
- ComponentTypeId is a unique identifier for a pizza component type.
- Must be a string representing the component type ID.
- A Product must be a Pizza Component.
- Non-stock-controlled Products have no consumption value.
- A pizza size is available only when
stock is sufficient to cover the
- PredefinedPizzaId is a unique identifier for a predefined pizza.
- Must be a string representing the pizza ID.
ComponentIds identify Products designated as Pizza Components.
The price of a pizza is recalculated from its final component configuration.
A pizza remains visible in the catalogue even when unavailable.
- StockId is a unique identifier for a stock item.
- Must be a string representing the stock ID.
componentIds reference Products designated as Pizza Components.
Catalogue pizza allergens derive from these components.
Product stores category/allergen identifiers, not Category or Allergen objects.
BCK11 loads those aggregates by ID to provide category and allergen names.
FIXED uses basePrice; COMPONENT_BASED requires a PredefinedPizza.
A component-based Product without one is invalid catalogue data.
